description: Expenses of one user on one day, with category, amount, VAT and receipt info (GET /api/v2/expenses/{userId}/{day}). Required: user_id, day (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). For expense totals over a period use get_ehour_report with columns such as EXPENSE_CATEGORY_NAME,EXPENSE_COST. Read-only.
name: list_ehour_expenses
